'''Farewell To Pikachu?!''' (Japanese: '''ピカチュウとの別れ!?''' ''Farewell To Pikachu!?'') is the twenty second chapter of the [[Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Eusine]] explains [[Time Capsule|how]] and why he sent {{TP|Gold|Pikachu}} [[Time travel|back in time]].
* {{GnB|Gold}} refuses to hand Pikachu to Eusine.
* [[Chuck]] declares a battle to decide who gets to keep Pikachu.
* Gold and {{GnB|Chris}} send the [[Secret Medicine|SecretPotion]] to [[Olivine City]].
* Gold battles Eusine and wins, getting to keep Pikachu.
* {{GnB|Black}} unseals the [[Black Tyranitar]], which goes on a rampage.
